exact: G protein activated inward rectifier potassium channel activity
G protein enhanced inward rectifier potassium channel activity
G-protein enhanced inward rectifier potassium channel activity
G-protein-activated inward rectifier potassium channel activity
G-protein-enhanced inward rectifier potassium channel activity

definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by an inwardly-rectifying voltage-gated channel, where the inward rectification is due to a voltage-dependent block of the channel pore by a G protein. An inwardly rectifying current-voltage relation is one where at any given driving force the inward flow of K+ ions exceeds the outward flow for the opposite driving force.
label: Activation of GIRK/Kir3 Channels
